title: What a divorce coach wishes couples knew before ending a marriage
summary: Divorce is a tool, not a weapon, says Karen McNenny, author of a new book on the subject. She explains how to end a marriage while protecting your family and your mental health.
contentText:
The Good Divorce: How to End Your Marriage Without Ending Your Family .'/> Divorce is a tool, not a weapon, says Karen McNenny, author of a new book on the subject. She explains how to end a marriage while protecting your family and your mental health.
